IRB Infrastructure Developers Ltd. to announce Q2 & H1 FY27                       
results on November 5th, 2026. 
November 2, 2026, Mumbai: IRB Infrastructure Developers Ltd. (Reuters: IRBI.BO, Bloomberg: IRB:IN, 
NSE: IRB, BSE: 532947) will announce results for the second quarter and half year ended September 
30th, 2026, on Thursday, November 5th 2026. The results will also be available on the Company website: 
www.irb.co.in. 
Earnings call (11.30 a.m. IST on November 6th, 2026) 
The Company will conduct an earnings call at 11.30 a.m. IST on Friday, November 6th, 2026. To 
participate in this conference call, please dial the numbers provided below, ten minutes ahead of the 
scheduled start time. The operator will provide instructions for participation and process for asking 
questions. A transcript of this conference call will be available on the website subsequently.
